arxiv-1406-5258.title: Location Aided Energy Balancing Strategy in Green Cellular Networks
arxiv-1406-5258.creator: Jianjun Yang, Bryson Payne, Markus Hitz, Zongming Fei, Le Li, Tongquan Wei
arxiv-1406-5258.description: Abstract Most cellular network communication strategies are focused on data traffic scenarios rather than energy balance and efficient utilization. Thus mobile users(cell phones) in hot cells may suffer from low throughput due to energy loading imbalance problem. In state-of-art cellular network technologies, relay stations extend cell coverage and enhance signal strength for mobile users.

arxiv-2107-01992.title: Eisenstein cohomology classes for GL N \displaystyle\mathrm{GL}_{N} over imaginary quadratic fields
arxiv-2107-01992.creator: Nicolas Bergeron, Pierre Charollois, Luis E. Garcia
arxiv-2107-01992.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nicolas Bergeron, Pierre Charollois, Luis E. Garcia. We study the arithmetic of degree N − 1 \displaystyle N-1 Eisenstein cohomology classes for the locally symmetric spaces attached to GL N \displaystyle\mathrm{GL}_{N} over an imaginary quadratic field k \displaystyle k . Under natural conditions we evaluate these classes on ( N − 1 ) \displaystyle(N-1) -cycles associated to degree N \displaystyle N extensions L / k \displaystyle L/k as linear combinations of generalised Dedekind sums.

arxiv-2402-14587.title: Small electron polarons bound to interstitial tantalum defects in lithium tantalate
arxiv-2402-14587.creator: Anton Pfannstiel, Tobias Hehemann, Nils A. Schäfer, Simone Sanna, Yuriy Suhak, Laura Vittadello, Felix Sauerwein, Niklas Dömer, Julian Koelmann, Holger Fritze, Mirco Imlau
arxiv-2402-14587.description: Abstract The absorption features of optically generated, short-lived small bound electron polarons are inspected in congruent lithium tantalate, LiTaO 3 (LT), in order to address the question whether it is possible to localize electrons at interstitial Ta V :V Li defect pairs by strong, short-range electron-phonon coupling.

arxiv-2408-12752.title: Transversal Clifford and T T -gate codes of short length and high distance
arxiv-2408-12752.creator: Shubham P. Jain, Victor V. Albert
arxiv-2408-12752.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shubham P. Jain, Victor V. Albert. The non-local interactions in several quantum device architectures allow for the realization of more compact quantum encodings while retaining the same degree of protection against noise. Anticipating that short to medium-length codes will soon be realizable, it is important to construct stabilizer codes that, for a given code distance, admit fault-tolerant implementations of logical gates with the fewest number of physical qubits.

arxiv-2412-06697.title: Inelastic H + H 3 + \mathrm{H}+\mathrm{H}_{3}^{+} Collision rates and their impact in the determination of the excitation temperature of H 3 + \mathrm{H}_{3}^{+}
arxiv-2412-06697.creator: Daniel Félix-González, Pablo del Mazo-Sevillano, Alfredo Aguado, Octavio Roncero, Jacques Le Bourlot, Evelyne Roueff, Franck Le Petit, Emeric Bron
arxiv-2412-06697.description: Abstract Context. In diffuse interstellar clouds the excitation temperature derived from the lowest levels of H 3 + \mathrm{H}_{3}^{+} is systematically lower than that derived from H 2 \mathrm{H}_{2} . The differences may be attributed to the lack of state-specific formation and destruction rates of H 3 + \mathrm{H}_{3}^{+} needed to thermalize the two species. Aims.

arxiv-2504-05335.title: Impact of Price Inflation on Algorithmic Collusion Through Reinforcement Learning Agents
arxiv-2504-05335.creator: Sebastián Tinoco, Andrés Abeliuk, Javier Ruiz del Solar
arxiv-2504-05335.description: Abstract Algorithmic pricing is increasingly shaping market competition, raising concerns about its potential to compromise competitive dynamics. While prior work has shown that reinforcement learning (RL)-based pricing algorithms can lead to tacit collusion, less attention has been given to the role of macroeconomic factors in shaping these dynamics.

pmc-11423375.title: Prevalence and Determinants of Household Access to Improved Latrine Utilization in Somalia: Health Demographic Survey (SHDS) 2020
pmc-11423375.creator: Hassan Abdi Ahmed, Dahir Abdi Ali
pmc-11423375.description: The aim of this research paper is to determine the prevalence of improved household latrine utilization and its determinants in Somalia, using the Somali Health Demographic Survey (SHDS) 2020 dataset. Limited sanitation is a major global problem mainly for the poor and disadvantaged. According to the SHDS 2020 report, around 22.3% of households in Somalia utilize unimproved toilet facilities.

pmc-11505398.title: Trimethylamine N-Oxide Aggravates Neuro-Inflammation via lncRNA Fendrr/miR-145-5p/PXN Axis in Vascular Dementia Rats
pmc-11505398.creator: Yang Deng, Rui Duan, Ye Hong, Qiang Peng, Zhong-Yuan Li, Xiang-Liang Chen, Ying-Dong Zhang
pmc-11505398.description: PurposeVascular dementia (VaD) is the second most common dementia in the world. An increasing number of studies have demonstrated the important role of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) in VaD. Our previous investigation demonstrated that Trimethylamine-N-oxide (TMAO) exacerbates cognitive impairment and neuropathological alterations in VaD rats. Thus, we hypothesized that TMAO could play an injury role in VaD by regulating lncRNAs.

pmc-12594052.title: Transdermal Drug Delivery Systems in Atopic Dermatitis: A Review of Vehicle Innovation and Skin Barrier Challenges
pmc-12594052.creator: Andres D Parga, Natasha Doshi, Riya M Bhat, Toan Vu, Kiratpreet Sraa, Stephanie Casagrande, Rahul Borra
pmc-12594052.description: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a chronic, relapsing inflammatory skin condition marked by immune dysregulation, pruritus, and impaired skin barrier function. Effective transdermal drug delivery is essential for therapeutic success but remains hindered by stratum corneum (SC) dysfunction and variable skin permeability.

pmc-12634824.title: Applying quality indicators and multidisciplinary team care to improve long-term survival in early-stage hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-12634824.creator: Hui-Ling Huang, Kuan-Chen Pan, Te-Sheng Chang, Shu-Chen Chen, Hsing-Ju Lu, Sheng-Nan Lu
pmc-12634824.description: ObjectiveEarly-stage hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is potentially curable; however, long-term survival depends on timely treatment and effective surveillance. In Taiwan, national quality indicators and multidisciplinary team (MDT) care have been promoted to improve cancer outcomes. This study aimed to examine the association between two quality indicators—curative treatment and post-treatment imaging—and MDT care among long-term survivors of early-stage HCC.

pmc-12974137.title: The invasion of Euphorbia jolkinii is mediated through the regulation of nitrogen transformation by functional microbial abundance in rhizosphere soils
pmc-12974137.creator: Xue Xiao, Qiongmei Niu, Kai Zhou, Laixiang Ma, Zhili Zhao, Jiangui Zhang, Xiaohui Chu, Guilian Shan
pmc-12974137.description: IntroductionEuphorbia jolkinii Boiss. is a native invasive weed. Its invasion altered microbial composition, total nitrogen (TN) and available nitrogen (AN). However, the mechanisms influencing N transformation remain unclear. Particularly, the roles of the microbiome and genes in mediating N transformations to facilitate E. jolkinii invasion remain poorly understood. Therefore, the primary objectives of this study were to evaluate how E.

pmc-13153254.title: Sex differences in the severity of non-motor symptoms in Parkinson’s disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13153254.creator: Calogero Edoardo Cicero, Claudio Terravecchia, Lavinia Lucia Pettinato, Silvia Tabbì, Giulia Donzuso, Donatella Contrafatto, Giovanni Mostile, Mario Zappia, Alessandra Nicoletti
pmc-13153254.description: Non-motor symptoms (NMS) in Parkinson’s Disease (PD) encompass a variety of symptoms which may differ in terms of presentation and severity according to gender. However, literature evidences are often conflicting due to the use of different instruments. The Non-Motor Symptoms Scale (NMSS) is a validated tool widely used to holistically assess NMSs in PD.

pmc-13253422.title: Integrating health promotion into biology education: effects of classroom and extracurricular interventions in rural adolescents
pmc-13253422.creator: Jie Chen, Ruiping Dang, Hua Tian
pmc-13253422.description: ObjectiveAim to explore the feasibility and preliminary impact of classroom-based and extracurricular interventions within eighth-grade biology curriculum to improve health promotion behavior (HPB) and multidimensional health of rural adolescents in China.MethodsAn exploratory study with two surveys was conducted at eighth-grade students in a Chinese rural middle school.

pmc-13256911.title: Molecular Engineering of Nicotinamide Riboside Kinase and Process Optimization for Efficient Nicotinamide Mononucleotide Production
pmc-13256911.creator: Dai Ma, Rui Liu, Tong Bao, Jingwen Yang, Hongbin Zhang, Xueqin Hu
pmc-13256911.description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) plays vital physiological roles as a vitamin B derivative, with nicotinamide riboside kinase (NRK) serving as a key enzyme for its efficient and environmentally friendly synthesis. In this study, semi-rational design was employed to modify the Hi-NRK enzyme at the molecular level, leading to the identification of a critical mutant, Hi-NRKG8S.

pmc-13358208.title: The Integrative and Conjugative Element ICEPmiW2 in Proteus mirabilis W2 Facilitates the Dissemination of Antibiotic‐Resistance Genes
pmc-13358208.creator: Yahan Cao, Wenchao Yu, Shweta Negi
pmc-13358208.description: BackgroundThe extensive use of antibiotics for treating infectious diseases leads to their release into the environment, which in turn results in antibiotic pollution and thereby facilitates the dissemination of antibiotic‐resistance genes (ARGs). Recently, despite the implementation of strict antibiotic usage restrictions, the accumulation of ARGs and multidrug‐resistant bacteria in the aquaculture environment continues to show a trend of persistent spread.

pmc-13499170.title: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency associated with increased risk of venous thromboembolism: a nationwide cohort study in Denmark
pmc-13499170.creator: Sine Voss David, Malin Fromme, Katharina Remih, Børge Grønne Nordestgaard, Pavel Strnad, Morten Dahl
pmc-13499170.description: BackgroundMechanistic investigations suggest that alpha-1 antitrypsin may influence hemostatic processes; however, whether alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency is associated with an elevated risk of venous thromboembolism is unclear.ObjectivesWe tested whether alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency is associated with venous thromboembolisms in 2 large independent cohorts.

pmc-13553885.title: Applying the NIMHD research framework to assess research capacity: lessons and adaptations for use
pmc-13553885.creator: Shelby L. Langer, Aliria M. Rascón, Heather M. Ross, Julia F. Hammett, Alyssa G. Robillard, Angel B. Algarin, Felipe Gonzalez Castro, Fiorella L. Carlos Chavez, Joseph Daniels, Kelly C. Davis, Rachel Gur-Arie, Rodney P. Joseph, Sunny W. Kim, Rebecca E. Lee, Derek R. Manis, Chung Jung Mun, Eyitayo O.
pmc-13553885.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The National Institute on Minority Health and Health Disparities Research Framework illustrates that health and health disparities are shaped by a complex interplay of factors that operate across multiple domains and levels of influence. We sought to apply the framework in a novel way, to examine and inform the collective work of an academic research center focused on health promotion and disease prevention.

pmc-13671004.title: Disseminated Mixed Lytic‐Sclerotic Skeletal Metastases as Initial Presentation of Gallbladder Carcinoma: A Case Report
pmc-13671004.creator: Shivali Rao, Binaya Adhikari, Abhikanta Khatiwada
pmc-13671004.description: Gallbladder carcinoma is an aggressive malignancy often diagnosed at an advanced stage. Skeletal metastasis, especially mixed lytic‐sclerotic lesions, is rare and typically occurs late. This report highlights an unusual presentation where widespread bony metastases were the initial manifestation, leading to the diagnosis of gallbladder carcinoma.
